claims: An RCD or residual current device protects against electric shock.
It automatically cuts off electricity when it detects a current leak.
It helps prevent electrical fires in households.
It monitors the balance of electrical current in live and neutral wires.

claims.text: A residual-current device interrupts an electrical circuit when the current passing through line and neutral conductors is not equal, indicating current leaking to ground.
The purpose of a residual-current device is to reduce the severity of injury caused by an electric shock.
A current imbalance causes a magnetic flux that activates a relay, forcing the contacts apart and cutting off the electricity supply to the appliance.
